# Infiterra’s planned AI onboarding studio leaves vendor activation with distributors


By OpenTools Team


Vendor onboarding and MSP purchasing connections describe different sides of the channel.


##


Preparation is not activation


[Infiterra’s November 2 announcement](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infiterra-democratizes-subscription-commerce-for-msps-and-it-distributors-302925298.html) says its AI‑assisted vendor onboarding studio is in development. It would assess new vendors and prepare integrations through the Ladder Integration Framework; the distributor’s own team would activate each vendor.


The proposed AI role is preparation, rather than automatic vendor activation or autonomous purchasing.


##


Two integration lists, different customers


[On the vendor‑platform side](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infiterra-democratizes-subscription-commerce-for-msps-and-it-distributors-302925298.html) , Microsoft integration is live, with AWS and Google on the roadmap.


For MSPs buying from distributors, Ingram Micro is already connected, while Pax8 and TD SYNNEX integrations are developing. Adding a vendor to a distributor’s marketplace and connecting an MSP to distributors are different jobs. Infiterra says roadmap items may change.


Engineers pair programming, December 2012; archive context, not Infiterra staff, software or an integration test.
